text:
Anya: quick proto idea  add a 'soft-cut' degrade mode to rollouts: switch to low-cost variant + cap tokens instead of full fallback.
Mike: ok but we need clear signals: 5xx spike, p99 latency, quota burn. how do we combine them?
Anya: rule engine supports boolean + weighted thresholds. e.g. ((5xx>2% AND p99>1s) OR token_burn>20%) => soft-cut.
Elaine: audit must be deterministic. each trigger emits a breadcrumb with reason codes and a sample_id. retention 30d default.
Sam: clients see a non-breaking field?
Anya: add `redwood.degrade_info` nullable in response body containing `{mode,truncated,true_reason}`. SDKs will map it.
Mike: console: show degrade-rate, reasons histogram, and a small heatmap by route/model. clickable pill opens inspector.
Elaine: inspector needs scrubbed samples + consent flow for operators. exports CSV (ts, route, reason, sample_id, operator_action).
Sam: runtime hook: decision proto input `{route,model_ver,latency,error_class,quota_state}` -> action `{allow|soft_cut|fallback}` + tags. keep proto tiny.
Anya: simulation mode on console: replay historical traces through rules, estimate cost delta and user-visible truncation.
Mike: avoid mid-stream switches. evaluate at request start only. add hysteresis window to prevent flapping.
Elaine: ops override: pause soft-cut for N minutes with auditable comment. bot logs it.
ops-bot: notice: soft-cut policy created in sandbox. `/ops list-policies`
Anya: next: I'll mock UI pill + inspector; Mike drafts proto; Elaine drafts export; Sam will plan SDK mapping.
Mike: got it, proto sketch today.
Elaine: will loop in legal once schema draft ready.
Sam: will prepare SDK compatibility checklist.
Anya: thanks, will share Figma link when ready. :thumbsup:
